answer_1.quote: Our approach works as follows: We generate a set of outputs for two different prompts or models and then automatically extract descriptions of the differences... We demonstrate the method on story generation, text summarization, and opinion answering scenarios.
answer_1.outputs: Long generated texts (stories, summaries, opinion answers)

answer_2.quote: As evaluation metrics we calculate precision, recall, and their harmonic mean, F1 score between the ground truth patterns and the patterns retrieved by the different methods.

answer_3.quote: We evaluate the LLM-based methods, we run Llama models locally ... and GPT-4o via the OpenAI API. We use the prompt: "You are given texts from two different groups. Please identify words or phrases that are systematically different between the texts of the two groups..."

answer_4.quote: We ran a user study to evaluate how difficult it is for users to identify significant differences between groups of LLM-generated texts; participants (n = 50) were recruited on the crowdworking platform Prolific.
answer_4.guideline: Participants were asked to identify systematic differences between two groups of texts, optionally using provided token patterns.
